newsitem.title: USA: Cardon refinery hit by power outage for four hours.
newsitem.headline: Cardon refinery hit by power outage for four hours.

text.p: The 305,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) Cardon refinery operated by Maraven, a unit of state Petroleos de Venezuela, was hit by a full power outage over the weekend, a Maraven official said Monday.
The plant was down for four hours from 1930 EDT/2330 GMT Sunday but the process to restart is underway, an official said.
An electric storm caused the outage.
"We are now purging the system...and are in the process of bringing it back up....Clients will not be affected," the Maraven official said.
The official had no estimate of lost production but said it is hoped that the plant will be back up to full production by late Monday.
The Cardon plant had problems with a fluid catalytic cracking unit in early April and had to delay two gasoline cargoes, one headed to the U.S. and the other a South American destination.
The plant is one of the biggest in the region and an important source of gasoline and other petroleum products in U.S. Gulf and Latin American markets.
